title: Pew

description.en: A contribution graph for the AI-native era. See your coding tokens tell a story.
description.zh: AI 时代的贡献图，把不同编程工具的 Token 使用记录变成可见的轨迹。

description.en: The continuous neck enters from the bottom and right edge, with the ears, wink, muzzle, and rainbow tongue kept inside the rounded tile.
description.zh: 颈部从底部与右侧自然延伸出画面，耳朵、眨眼、鼻口和彩虹舌头完整留在圆角图标内。

description.en: Broad ivory and charcoal planes carry the familiar zebra. Smaller facets articulate the wink, dark nose, and little rainbow tongue.
description.zh: 大块象牙白与炭黑平面保留熟悉的斑马，细一些的切面刻画眨眼、深色鼻子与彩虹舌头。

description.en: Tapered stripes fan through the lilac negative space, with fine light edges and shallow shadows. Their geometry echoes the zebra’s markings and belongs only to Pew.
description.zh: 舒展的条纹掠过淡紫色留白，细亮边与浅阴影带出浮雕质感。纹样呼应斑马的条纹，为 Pew 单独设计。

sizeNote.en: At 16 px the striped silhouette leads; the wink and individual facets merge, while the rainbow tongue becomes a small color accent.
sizeNote.zh: 缩到 16 px 时，黑白条纹轮廓承担辨识度；眨眼与细碎切面会合并，彩虹舌头成为一小点彩色装饰。
